run_phosa_demo: run the PHOSA demo script on an image to optimize human-object spatial arrangements
run_demo_with_custom_loss_weights: run the demo with custom loss weights like --lw_inter 0 to disable coarse interaction loss
run_demo_with_save_metadata: run the demo with --save_metadata to export computed model parameters as JSON
review_get_args: review the get_args function that parses CLI arguments for filename, class_name, and loss weights
review_main: review the main function that runs segmentation, human estimation, pose optimization, and visualization
